images.name: vision-main
images.title: Regional fabrication and innovation
images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished bitmap illustration for a university fabrication and manufacturing research center website, matching the supplied visual references. Reference image 1 is a Services-page screenshot: use ONLY the maroon image-panel artwork style and palette, not the website interface, cards, text, icons for preview, or browser. Reference image 2 is a maintenance poster: use ONLY its simple flat illustrated person style and clean editorial shapes, not its words or layout. Full-bleed landscape 16:10 canvas, high-resolution PNG. Deep wine-maroon background, approximately #641321 fading subtly to #3D0812. Restrained lighter maroon circular halo behind the central subject, with soft tonal curved shapes and a very fine curved arc at upper left and lower right, matching the Services artwork. Central illustration in warm ivory #F3E5D8 and pale cream, clean confident rounded linework and a few solid flat fills. Use simplified faceless figures where requested, with minimal stylized hands. Crisp vector-like graphic design rendered as a PNG, evenly weighted outlines, elegant negative space, visually balanced, polished institutional identity. Main motif centered in the middle 65 percent, with at least 10 percent breathing space from every edge, suitable for a 16:10 crop. No photography, photorealism, 3D renders, material textures, shadows suggesting real objects, realistic faces, gradients on the subjects, words, letters, numbers, logos, seals, captions, watermark, borders, collage panels, or website UI. Keep the actual fabrication devices recognizable and mechanically plausible in simplified icon form.
Scene: A balanced connected illustration grouping: a central enclosed 3D printer forming a simple geometric prototype, a clean CAD monitor on the left, a precision milling machine on the right, and one small gear-and-spark motif above suggesting innovation. Clear restrained detail, a unified wide composition, no human figures.
